title: A Letter to Grandma
text: Dear Grandma, How are you? Two months passed since your last visit. I miss you very much. School is going well. I like my English class best. Last week, I won a prize in the singing contest. Mom made a big cake to celebrate. Dad took many photos. The weather here is cool and windy. Autumn is beautiful. The leaves are yellow and red. I put a small maple leaf in this envelope. I hope you like it. Please come to our home soon. We can bake cookies together and watch old movies. With love, your granddaughter, Lily.
translation: 亲爱的奶奶：您好吗？距离您上次来看我们已经过去两个月了。我非常想念您。学校一切都好，我最喜欢英语课。上周，我在歌唱比赛中得了奖。妈妈做了一个大蛋糕庆祝，爸爸拍了很多照片。这里的天气凉爽多风。秋天真美，树叶黄黄红红。我在这封信里夹了一片小枫叶，希望您喜欢。请早点来我们家吧。我们可以一起烤饼干，看老电影。爱您的孙女，莉莉。

words.example: She won first prize in the race.
Our class joined a singing contest.
The maple leaves turn red in autumn.
